title: Parts Book + Maintenance Intelligence
brief: Build HandbookMaintenanceIntelligenceEngine that extracts PM intervals, lubrication schedules, consumable specifications, and parts BOM from handbook maintenance and parts sections. Provides maintenance cost modeling and interval tracking for business pipeline consumption.

units.title: Extract PM schedules from handbook maintenance sections: interval-based tasks (daily, weekly, monthly, annual), hour-based tasks (500h, 1000h, 5000h), and condition-based triggers
Extract parts BOM from handbook parts sections: part numbers, descriptions, quantities, cross-references to aftermarket equivalents, and consumable categories (filters, belts, seals, lubricants)
Build HandbookMaintenanceIntelligenceEngine with maintenance cost model: estimate annual maintenance cost per machine from PM intervals, parts costs, and labor estimates

exit_conditions: PM schedules extracted from sample handbooks include at least 15 distinct maintenance tasks with correct intervals
Parts BOM extraction captures part numbers and descriptions with >85% accuracy on test samples
Maintenance cost model produces annual cost estimate per machine with itemized breakdown
